Is there anything else I can help you with?

That information isn't available in the policy excerpts I have access to. I can confirm from **kb/09-account-faq.md** that Trailforge does have a loyalty/rewards program where you earn **1 point per dollar spent**, and that points can be redeemed for discounts on future orders — but the specific redemption rate (e.g., how many points equal $10 off) is not included in the policies available to me.

For the exact redemption details, I'd recommend reaching out to our support team directly:

- **Chat:** Available on the website during business hours (fastest option, typically under 5 min)
- **Email:** support@trailforge.example (within 1 business day)
- **Phone:** 1-800-555-0199 (Mon–Fri 9 AM–6 PM MT, Sat 10 AM–2 PM MT)

*(kb/13-contact-support.md)*

I've escalated your case to a specialist. Here's what to expect:

- **A specialist will review your case and follow up within one business day.**
- I've shared all the relevant details with them: your order number **TF-20911**, the item received (Ridge Jacket in moss), and your request for a full refund of $220 due to receiving the wrong color.

I can't promise a specific outcome, but the team will be in touch shortly to get this sorted out. Is there anything else I can help you with in the meantime?

Great news — you're still well within the return window! According to our **[kb/01-return-policy.md]** policy:

- You have **30 days from the delivery date** to return most items for a full refund.
- Since your jacket was delivered last week, you have roughly **3 weeks remaining**.

Here are a few things to keep in mind for your return:

- The jacket must be **unused, in original packaging, and in resalable condition**.
- You'll need your **order number** to initiate the return.
- **Return shipping costs are your responsibility** for a standard change-of-mind return.
- Once we receive and inspect the item, your refund will be issued to your original payment method within **5–7 business days**.

Whenever you're ready to start the return, just reach out with your order number and we'll confirm eligibility and send you return authorization and shipping instructions. Is there anything else I can help you with?
